system.description:
When you slip free from your opponent, you can deliver a parting attack.

Prerequisite: Trained in Acrobatics

Effect: When you successfully use Acrobatics to escape a Grapple, you can spend a Swift Action to make a single attack with a melee weapon or an Unarmed attack against the opponent that had Grappled you. If the attack hits, it deals normal damage, and your opponent is considered Flat-Footed until the start of its next turn.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Scum and Villainy
